pressure_note: 0.6 MPa (title: at 0.6 MPa); pressures accurate to +-50 kPa
extra_unmapped: 10^2 x [(cp rho/cp1* rho1*) - 1] (dimensionless, printed x 1e-2; measured volume heat capacity ratio minus 1 at T2; moved from value2 because the builder reads value2 as absolute density)
title_as_printed: Experimental Values of the Quantities [(cp rho/cp,1* rho1*) - 1], (rho - rho1*), Cp,phi(mean), and V phi(mean) for the Ternary Solutions [MgCl2(aq) + NaCl(aq)], [CaCl2(aq) + NaCl(aq)], and [MgCl2(aq) + CaCl2(aq)] at 0.6 MPa

footnotes_as_printed.a: a is the ratio of the volume heat capacity of the solution to that of water; (rho - rho1*) is the difference between the density of the solution and that of water; Cp,phi(mean) is the apparent molar heat capacity; V phi(mean) is the apparent molar volume. (experimental values)
footnotes_as_printed.b: I/(mol kg-1) is the ionic strength of the solution.

T.note: temperature of the density measurement (the vibrating-tube densimeter runs in series with the calorimeter, at a slightly different temperature)

T2.note: temperature belonging to value2 and the heat capacity columns

value.what: density of solution minus density of pure water at the same T and P (water reference values from Haar et al. 1983)

composition.other_species: mixed solutions of two of NaCl, MgCl2, CaCl2; first and second salt are in the order printed in the block's column headers (NaCl first for NaCl+MgCl2 and NaCl+CaCl2; MgCl2 first for MgCl2+CaCl2)

notes: Printed as side-by-side blocks. Restacked to long form: per salt pair, left printed blocks first (298.15 K block, then 348.15 K block), then right printed blocks (323.15 K, then 373.15 K); the printed page has 298.15/323.15 in the upper block and 348.15/373.15 in the lower block. Temperature pair (heat capacity T, density T) written into every row. Note the density temperature printed for 298.15 K is 296.02 K here versus 297.05 K in Table 1, as printed.
